name: saksham
description: Saksham — AI-driven voice assistant for livelihood mapping and NSQF-aligned skilling recommendations for SC communities under PM-AJAY (MoSJE). Monorepo: React Native app + Express/Prisma backend + Next.js website.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix website install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix website run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && website/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p website/tsconfig.json && app/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p app/tsconfig.json
scripts.demo:website: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000 NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:8081 npm --prefix website run dev
scripts.test:career:e2e: CAREER_E2E=1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:8081 npm --prefix website run test:e2e -- career.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:voice:e2e: VOICE_E2E=1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:8081 npm --prefix website run test:e2e -- voice.spec.ts --workers=1
